[Fuzzel](https://codeberg.org/dnkl/fuzzel) is an app launcher and fuzzy finder for <a href="Wayland" class="wikilink" title="Wayland">Wayland</a> inspired by <a href="rofi" class="wikilink" title="rofi">rofi</a> and [dmenu](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Dmenu).
